description: This Java class 'ServiceConfigUtil' provides utility methods for managing and accessing service configuration data, including loading configuration from 'serviceengine.xml', caching the configuration, and notifying listeners of configuration changes.

classes.name: ServiceConfigUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing service configuration, including loading, caching, and notifying listeners about configuration changes.

methods.name: getEngineParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific parameter from a named service engine.

methods.name: getServiceConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton ServiceConfig instance, loading and caching it if necessary, and notifies registered listeners of changes.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Returns a specific ServiceEngine configuration by name.

methods.name: getXmlDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses the 'serviceengine.xml' configuration file into a Document object.

methods.name: registerServiceConfigListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when the service configuration is reloaded.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the name of the default engine ('default').

methods.name: getServiceEngineXmlFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the service engine configuration XML ('serviceengine.xml').
